title: Evaluation under binary sign encoding
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on $n$ coordinates whose inputs and outputs are signs in $\{ -1,1\}$, with available coordinates $A$, and let $x$ be a binary vector in $(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^n$. The associated $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$-valued decision tree evaluated at $x$ equals the real value of the sign obtained by evaluating $T$ at the coordinatewise sign encoding of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with sign inputs and sign outputs, on n coordinates and available set A
A binary vector x : Fin n → ZMod 2
